notes.title: Version 2 Released!
notes.content:
I'm proud to announce that version 2 of Record Store Nightmare is now available. The game has a complete graphical overhaul, as well as some game play and sound updates.

I hope you enjoy this new version. Thank you!

notes.title: Graphical Refresh Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Version 2 of Record Store Nightmare is almost ready for release! In this free update, you will find a complete graphical overhaul as well as sound and game play changes. If you want to see a preview of the graphics, [url=https://www.hotseatgames.com/2019/01/13/record-store-nightmare-update-coming/]check the website here[/url].

Voice lines for the record pickups will now play much less often. When they don't play, a simple confirmation sound effect will play.

Compact discs are easier to earn now as well. I look forward to releasing this update to you very soon. Thank you very much!

-Mark
